title: Angiotensin II promotes erythroid proliferation in a three-stage erythroid culture system
author: Poldee, Metheetrairut, et al.

steps.title: Dilute blood and perform density gradient
steps.instruction: Collect ~2 ml of blood remaining in each discarded LRS cone, add 2 ml HBSS (H6648, Sigma‑Aldrich) containing 0.6 % (v/v) citrate dextrose solution (ACD, C3821), layer the diluted blood over 4 ml Ficoll‑Histopaque‑1077 (H8889, Sigma‑Aldrich), and centrifuge at 400 g for 30 min at 20 °C.

steps.title: Collect mononuclear cells and lyse red cells
steps.instruction: Harvest the middle interface containing mononuclear cells, wash twice with 10 ml HBSS containing 0.6 % ACD, add pre‑warmed red‑cell lysis buffer (150 mM NH4Cl [A0171], 1 mM EDTA·2H2O [BDH4616], 10 mM KHCO3 [PT1195], pH 7.5 adjusted with NaOH [S318‑500]), and incubate for 12 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend cells in cold MACS buffer
steps.instruction: Spin down the lysed cells, wash once with 10 ml HBSS containing 0.6 % ACD, resuspend the pellet in cold MACS buffer (0.5 % BSA [A8806], 0.6 % citrate‑phosphate‑dextrose [CPD, C7165] in 1× PBS [D1408]), and centrifuge at 400 g for 5 min at 20 °C.

steps.title: Block Fc receptors and label CD34+ cells
steps.instruction: After a MACS‑buffer wash, incubate the cells in 500 µl cold MACS buffer containing 100 µl MACS‑Fc blocking agent and 100 µl MACS‑CD34 beads (MiniMacs direct CD34+ kit, 130‑406‑703, Miltenyi) for 30 min at 4 °C while mixing continuously on a roller.

steps.title: Column purification and elution of CD34+ cells
steps.instruction: Wash the labeled cells once with 5 ml cold MACS buffer, resuspend the pellet in 3 ml cold MACS buffer, apply to a pre‑wet LS column, wash the column three times with 1.5 ml cold MACS buffer, elute with 2 ml cold MACS buffer, then apply the eluate to a pre‑wet MS column, wash the MS column three times with 0.5 ml cold MACS buffer, and finally elute the CD34+ cells with 1 ml cold MACS buffer.
